html.title: Early Modern BnF Portal
html.description: Faceted search over the harmonised BnF early modern editions and actors knowledge graph

appTitle.subheading: Editions and actors from data.bnf.fr, harmonised and linked as a CHAD-AP knowledge graph

appDescription1: This portal searches the knowledge graph produced by the Early Modern BnF Harmonisation pipeline: editions retrieved from data.bnf.fr, their places, publishers and languages harmonised, and the people and organisations who wrote, edited, translated or illustrated them.
appDescription2: Choose a perspective, then narrow the results with the facets on the left. Every table, map and chart reflects the active filters.

instancePageGeneral.introduction:
This landing page provides a human-readable summary of the data points that link to this {entity}. The data included in this summary reflect only those data points used in the MMM Portal. Click the Open in Linked Data Browser on button on the Export tab to view the complete set of classes and properties linked to this record.

To cite this record, use its url. You can use also use the url to return directly to the record at any time.
instancePageGeneral.repetition:
Repetition of data

The same or similar data may appear within a single data field multiple times. This repetition occurs due to the merging of multiple records from different datasets to create the MMM record.

aboutThePortalPartOne:
About the portal

The data comes from module 07 of the Early Modern BnF Harmonisation pipeline, a knowledge graph built to the CHAD-AP application profile from data.bnf.fr records, after module 04 harmonised places, publishers, languages, names and dates and module 06 linked actors to external authorities.
aboutThePortalPartTwo: Shared places and publishers, year values and role shortcuts are a portal layer derived from that graph each time it is loaded; the CHAD-AP triples themselves are unchanged. The graph is rebuilt whenever the pipeline runs again, so counts here follow the latest run.
instructions:
Instructions

Pick a perspective. Facets on the left filter the results; the tabs switch between table, map, chart and export views of the same filtered set.

exportLink.viewInstructions: Choose the tab in which the query will open
exportLink.infoBody: You can share the query you made by using the link below. The link is generated based on what you have selected for different facets and will open the search view of this perspective with those choices on the selected tab. You can change the opened tab to any of the supported ones using the dropdown menu below. If you make additional choices while on this page, the link will be automatically updated to include those.

exportLink.warningBody: The current length of the generated link is more than 2,000 characters. Browsers have different limits for the maximum lengths of links they can handle. This link might not work on all browsers — you can reduce the length of the link by deselecting some facet options.

editions.label: Editions
editions.shortDescription: Printed editions catalogued by the BnF, with harmonised place, publisher and language
editions.longDescription: Each row is one edition (an LRMoo manifestation). Place and publisher are module 04's harmonised values; the place as recorded in the catalogue is kept on the edition page. The map shows editions by harmonised place of publication; the chart counts editions per decade of first publication.

instancePage.label: Edition
instancePage.description: An edition as described in the knowledge graph.

prefLabel.label: Title
prefLabel.description: Title of the edition (shortened in the table).

contributor.label: Other contributors
contributor.description: Editors, translators and illustrators, with their role.

placeAsRecorded.label: Place as recorded
placeAsRecorded.description: The place statement as it appears in the BnF record.

publisher.label: Publisher
publisher.description: Harmonised publisher name, or the recorded one when no harmonised value exists.

description.label: Physical description
description.description: Extent and format notes from the record.

digitalCopy.label: Digital copy
digitalCopy.description: Link to a digitised copy, for example on Gallica.

estcRecord.label: ESTC record
estcRecord.description: The same edition in the English Short Title Catalogue, matched by module 06 (03_map_estc_ecco.py) on author, year and title.

actors.label: Actors
actors.shortDescription: People and organisations credited on those editions, linked to external authorities
actors.longDescription: Each row is one BnF authority record for a person or an organisation. Roles come from the editions they are credited on; external links are the authority identifiers (VIAF, Wikidata, ISNI and others) carried by the BnF record.

instancePage.label: Actor
instancePage.description: A person or organisation as described in the knowledge graph.

prefLabel.label: Name
prefLabel.description: Full name, or surname when no full name is recorded.

gender.label: Gender
gender.description: Gender as recorded by the BnF.

country.label: Country
country.description: Country associated with the actor (LOC country code).

role.label: Role
role.description: Roles held on at least one edition.

edition.label: Editions
edition.description: Editions the actor is credited on, in any role.

externalLink.label: External links
externalLink.description: Authority records for the same actor elsewhere.
